calls.statement:
SELECT tier, is_current, COUNT(*) AS n_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS n_members, MIN(valid_from) AS min_from, MAX(valid_to) AS max_to,
 SUM(CASE WHEN valid_to = DATE '9999-12-31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS open_ended
FROM dim_member GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

WITH per AS (
 SELECT member_id, COUNT(*) AS versions, SUM(CASE WHEN is_current THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cur_rows,
  SUM(CASE WHEN valid_to = DATE '9999-12-31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS open_rows,
  SUM(CASE WHEN DATE '2026-10-08' BETWEEN valid_from AND valid_to THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS valid_today,
  SUM(CASE WHEN DATE '2026-10-04' BETWEEN valid_from AND valid_to THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS valid_load
 FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1)
SELECT cur_rows, open_rows, valid_today, valid_load, COUNT(*) AS members FROM per GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3,4

calls.statement:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS rows_total, COUNT(DISTINCT member_key) AS keys, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS members,
 SUM(CASE WHEN member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1 HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN is_current THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=1) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS odd_rows,
 MAX(valid_from) AS max_from, SUM(CASE WHEN valid_from > valid_to THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inverted,
 SUM(CASE WHEN member_id IS NULL OR tier IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nulls
FROM dim_member

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS gold_members,
 SUM(CASE WHEN join_date > DATE '2026-10-08' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS future_join,
 SUM(CASE WHEN home_store_id = 999 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS home999,
 SUM(CASE WHEN home_store_id = 900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS online,
 SUM(CASE WHEN valid_from > DATE '2026-10-04' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS from_after_load
FROM dim_member WHERE is_current AND tier = 'Gold'
